items.title: Kyren Williams: Rush TD on inefficient night
items.text:
Williams rushed 16 times for 49 yards and a touchdown and brought in six of eight targets for 27 yards in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Matthew Stafford: Massive yardage total in OT loss
items.text:
Stafford completed 40 of 54 passes for 383 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Josh Allen: Late-game heroics in OT win
items.text:
Allen completed 12 of 19 passes for 210 yards with one touchdown and one interception while adding 10 carries for 121 yards and another score and a two-point conversion pass in the Bills' 37-34 overtime win against the Rams on Monday night.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: James Cook: Stellar night nearly ruined by fumble
items.text:
Cook rushed 10 times for 121 yards and a touchdown and brought in his only target for seven yards in the Bills' 37-34 overtime win over the Rams on Monday night. He also committed two fumbles, losing one.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Puka Nacua: Career-best numbers in OT loss
items.text:
Nacua brought in 17 of 24 targets for 138 yards and a touchdown  and rushed twice for nine yards in the Rams' 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills on Monday night.
